## Working papers

::: {.paper-card}
### [Characteristic Geometry and Portfolio Choice](characteristic-geometry.qmd)
Characteristics can describe overlapping stock exposures. The Gram matrix measures their scale and overlap; used as a normalisation rule it changes loading units, and a fixed numerical factor ridge can then change a portfolio's exposure penalty even when forecasts nearly agree.
